ready_meaning: This exact source/raw exterior observation point is ready for later browser testing only.
scope: One fixed exterior start, a conservative torso/camera envelope and three finite actual-raw rays. No physical ground, access, full avatar motion or camera-sweep claim.

actual_body_and_camera_envelopes.method: Each envelope is computed afresh from loaded actual Float32 triangles; segment_hit tests its radius-expanded AABB. Possible hits are never discarded.

limitations: Source map boundary is replacement geometry; the independently interpreted design wall is recorded separately.
The design may be a working model revision. Re-run against the finally confirmed calibration and actual raw before a ready proposal.
Current-source neighbor screening is bounded to this macro and150m around the compound, not the entire city.
OSM labels, closed-ring containment and estimated5m road corridors do not establish surveyed ground, safe public access, stairs or furniture.
Nominal default ground offset is zero; controller defaults, two finite probes and a sightline are not full avatar motion or camera-sweep simulation.
Ready applies only to this exact current raw, calibration, source and controller. Changed source/model bytes require new checks.
Actual closed-solid rays test one boom line and one facade line with two depth intervals. They do not certify rendering, opacity, whole-facade framing or all camera motion.
Body radius0.38m around axis z=.38..1.75 conservatively spans z=0..2.13m. Ground height, steps, foot support and public access remain unverified.
The source table49-building screen and closed mapped square ring are bounded map evidence. They are not live MVT visibility or measured terrain.
Roof/canopy structural support, native visual review and whole-model acceptance are independent; this result does not change their state.
